user.title: IPMI Connection
user.description: Enter the connection details for your IPMI host.

data_description.host: A short name for this host
data_description.ip: The IP address of the BMC/IPMI interface
data_description.privilege_level: Administrator enables fan mode and threshold control. Operator is read-only.
data_description.addon_url: URL of the IPMI Control add-on. Leave the default if running the add-on locally; change it if the add-on is hosted elsewhere.

power.title: Power Control
power.description: Configure power control policy and polling interval.

data_description.power_control: Select which power operations are allowed for this host
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the BMC for state changes (5-300 seconds)
data_description.power_state_hold: How long to hold the expected state after a power command (0 to disable)
data_description.hard_off_disarm_timeout: How long the hard power off stays armed before auto-disarming (5-300 seconds)

fan_profile.title: Fan Control
fan_profile.description: Select a motherboard profile for fan mode control.

data_description.motherboard: Select 'none' to skip fan control, or a profile to enable fan mode management

sensor_select.title: Sensor Selection
sensor_select.description: Select BMC sensors to expose in Home Assistant, or enter names manually. Leave both empty to skip.

data_description.manual_sensors: Enter sensor names manually if SDR discovery failed or is incomplete

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate IPMI
reauth_confirm.description: The IPMI credentials are no longer valid. Please enter updated credentials.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure IPMI Host
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for this IPMI host.

data_description.addon_url: URL of the IPMI Control add-on. Leave the default if running the add-on locally; change it if the add-on is hosted elsewhere.

error.addon_not_reachable: Cannot reach the IPMI Control add-on. Make sure it is installed and running.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to IPMI host
error.insufficient_privilege: Credentials do not have Administrator access. Select Operator privilege level or use an Administrator account.
error.sdr_query_failed: Failed to query sensors from BMC. You can enter sensor names manually below.

abort.already_configured: This IPMI host is already configured

init.title: IPMI Control Options
init.description: Adjust power control, polling, and fan profile settings.

data_description.power_control: Select which power operations are allowed for this host
data_description.hard_off_disarm_timeout: How long the hard power off stays armed before auto-disarming (5-300 seconds)

virtual_modes.title: Virtual Fan Modes
virtual_modes.description: Manage user-defined virtual fan modes ({virtual_mode_count} configured). A virtual mode has no direct BMC equivalent — it runs a custom raw IPMI command sequence and reports back as the closest real mode the BMC understands.

virtual_mode_edit.title: Virtual Fan Mode
virtual_mode_edit.description: Define a virtual fan mode from a raw IPMI command sequence.

data_description.virtual_mode_internal_name: A short slug (lowercase letters, numbers, underscores) used internally. Must not match an existing fan mode or another virtual mode.
data_description.virtual_mode_display_name: The name shown in the Fan Mode select entity, e.g. 'Quiet'.
data_description.virtual_mode_maps_to: The real fan mode the BMC will report while this virtual mode is active.
data_description.virtual_mode_commands: One raw IPMI command per line, e.g. '0x30 0x45 0x01 0x00'. The first byte is netfn, the second is command, and any remaining bytes are data.

sensor_select.title: Sensor Selection
sensor_select.description: Select BMC sensors to expose in Home Assistant, or enter names manually. Leave both empty to skip.

data_description.manual_sensors: Enter sensor names manually if SDR discovery failed or is incomplete

threshold_sensor_select.title: Threshold Configuration
threshold_sensor_select.description: Select sensors to configure threshold overrides for. Only sensors that report thresholds are shown.

sensor_thresholds.title: Thresholds for {sensor_name}
sensor_thresholds.description: Set the threshold values for {sensor_name}. Values are pre-filled from the BMC.

error.sdr_query_failed: Failed to query sensors from BMC. You can enter sensor names manually below.
error.invalid_internal_name: Internal name must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores
error.duplicate_internal_name: This name is already used by another fan mode or virtual mode
error.commands_too_short: Each command line needs at least a netfn and a command byte
error.commands_invalid_hex: Commands must be hex byte values, e.g. 0x30 0x45 0x01 0x00
error.commands_byte_range: Byte values must be between 0x00 and 0xff

force_power_off.name: Force power off
force_power_off.description: Immediately cut power to an IPMI host (hard power off), bypassing a graceful shutdown. Requires the host to be armed first via its "Power Off (Arm)" switch, unless confirm is set to true.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The force power off button entity of the target host.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Set to true to execute immediately without requiring the host to be pre-armed via its "Power Off (Arm)" switch.
